_authority: Schedule II to the Companies Act, 2013 (Part C), as amended by MCA Notification G.S.R. 237(E) dated 31-03-2014 and subsequent amendments.
_note: Schedule II prescribes USEFUL LIVES, not rates. Depreciation rates are derived from the life. A company may adopt a different life only with technical justification disclosed in the notes (Sch II Part A para 3). Residual value shall not normally exceed 5% of original cost (Part A para 5).
_verify_before_use: Rates here are derived, not quoted. Re-verify against the current Schedule II text before relying on them for a filing. Amendments are notified by MCA and are not always widely reported.

assets.class: Buildings (other than factory), RCC frame structure
Computers and data processing units — end user devices (desktops, laptops, printers)
Computers and data processing units — servers and networks
Motor vehicles — motor cycles, scooters, other mopeds
Motor vehicles — motor buses/lorries/cars used in a business of running them on hire
Motor vehicles — motor cars (other than those used in a business of running them on hire)
Intangible assets (software) — amortised over useful life; AS 26 / Ind AS 38
assets.note: Schedule II does not prescribe a life for intangibles; AS 26 requires amortisation over useful life with a rebuttable presumption of 10 years. 3 years used here for software - MUST be confirmed.

unmatched_policy.note: An asset whose class cannot be determined from its ledger name is NEVER silently assigned a default. It is reported as UNCLASSIFIED for a human to assign, because a wrong life produces a wrong charge that still looks reasonable.
